name: lumen
description: Precise local semantic code search via MCP. Indexes your codebase with Go AST parsing, embeds with Ollama or LM Studio, and exposes vector search to Claude through an MCP server — no cloud, no npm.

node_command.title: Node binary
node_command.description: Path to the Node.js binary used to run the lumen launcher. Override (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/node) only when `node` is not visible to the spawn PATH.
